column1: Tab 8 — Decision Sequence (backend order, matches v2 spec Section 4's 11 layers)

column2: User opens app: state what they need help with, OR simply check in. No demand required at this point.
Capture Energy (1-4) x Mood (1-4) as ONE coupled coordinate. Look up Cell ID. Display name + plain-language description immediately.

Capture 1-3 emotions + intensity (0-10 or Mild/Moderate/High/Very High) each. Capture optional Sensations across six categories (Sensory, Cognitive, Body incl. pain with its own intensity, Communication, Movement, Interoception) + body map.

Match Experience + Context + stated Need against trigger rules. Output: one or more of Regulate / Dump / Express / Connect / Execute / Adapt / Reflect / Meditate, or none. Reflect and Meditate must also pass the Tab 6c gates (RF-1..RF-5, MD-1..MD-6).
Capture environment/social/time tags. Filter which specific tools within the chosen Intervention are realistic.
Capture desired activity/need. Absence is valid — route directly to step 10 using Intervention only (support-only journey).
If a demand exists: classify demand type, capture Timeline (T0-T6), capture explicit Need text/selection.

Apply the band safety modifiers in Tab 10 to the State baseline: Experience (e.g. High+ distress, shutdown, High+ pain sensation, sensory overload) and Context (2+ sensitivity flags in a public, formal or unfamiliar setting) can each lower the band by ONE step; total at most two steps; the band is never raised within a check-in (improvement only via re-check). Demand does not change the band. Final band: Available / Conditional / Constrained / Very Constrained, shown as a traffic-light indicator.
Only if a demand exists: tag the demand with driver(s) (Novelty/Urgency/Challenge/Routine/Interest/Passion/Collaboration/Exploration).
Combine Intervention (step 4) + NUCRIPCE tags (step 9, if any) + Timeline (step 7) into ONE primary CTA + up to 2 alternatives + plain-language rationale.

After the action, ask: helpful? effort? Optionally re-run steps 2-3 (re-check State/Experience). If a queued second Need exists (e.g. Regulate then Execute), auto-surface it once the first is marked complete. v3.1: if support was completed and the re-check improves from Yellow, Amber or Red, show the Blue Recovery light and keep demand gentle for the recovery window (Tab 10 RC-1 to RC-5); if not improved, offer a different route.
column3: Feedback log; loops back to step 2 if re-check requested

column2: Any immediate-risk option or free-text risk flag stops the flow and opens the support screen (Tab 7 pattern 28). The free-text classifier only FLAGS; it never decides or replies.
If the user taps 'Not sure' at the State step, run the body-first guided check-in and ask them to confirm a suggested state. If still unsure, continue as Conditional.
Every step's user inputs, system inputs, rule applied, internal outputs, user-visible outputs and logging are specified in Tab 11.

After gates and before the card: keep only tools the user's plan includes as the primary; if the best fit is Advanced and the user is on Free, use the best free tool in the same pathway and (Green/Yellow/Blue only) show the Advanced tool as one labelled alternative. Amber/Red: safety-floor tools only, no Advanced tiles.
